_comment: A fire elemental's burn field: applies a fire dot to every hostile entity within 2.0 units every 60 ticks, dealing 7 HP plus 1.8 per level over 3 ticks at 60-tick intervals, and casts light out to 2.5 units. Shared by both the normal and greater fire elemental; their difference comes from baseline stats, not this skill. All values placeholder.
name: FireElementalAura
